verdict.rationale: Jules' docs state directly that 'You'll be notified when the task completes or needs your input' (jules-docs-6), which matches the story. A community-quoted message asking the user to review work and give feedback shows input requests being surfaced in practice (jules-comm-3), and plan-approval checkpoints are documented points where input is needed (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-17). Missing for 10: details on notification channels (email, push, Slack, webhooks) and configuration, plus independent hands-on confirmation that notifications are actually delivered.
